components.description: Dual-Pivot Caliper Brakes. These brakes are easy to install and adjust, corrosion-resistant, and offer superior control, especially when carrying heavy loads.
each paired with a corresponding chainring via their own single-speed chain
2-Speed, 2-chain Drivetrain: switchable freewheel with two cogs

Heavy-Duty Aluminum Rims. The “deep-box section” aluminum rims provide high strength and lighter weight. Updated wheel construction with 3x lacing ensures consistent spoke tension and reduces spoke breakages.
